developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_hbr_backup_lifecycle_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce HBR Automated Backup Lifecycle & Retention (Tier-4 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_hbr_vault"
  not r.change.after.retention
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud ACK"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce HBR Automated Backup Lifecycle & Retention"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0231"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ack", label: "Alibaba Cloud ACK", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_oss_private_access_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Block Public Bucket Access via Bucket Policy (Tier-5 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.acl
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure acl for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud ACK"]

      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0232"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ack", label: "Alibaba Cloud ACK", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_ram_least_privilege_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce RAM Least Privilege & MFA Requirement (Tier-6 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_ram_policy"
  not r.change.after.policy_document
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure policy_document for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud ACK"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce RAM Least Privilege & MFA Requirement"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0233"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ack", label: "Alibaba Cloud ACK", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_storage_encryption_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enable Disk Encryption with Envelope KMS Master Key (Tier-7 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_disk"
  not r.change.after.encrypted
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure encrypted for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_actiontrail_audit_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Mandate ActionTrail Multi-Region Audit Logging (Tier-8 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_actiontrail_trail"
  not r.change.after.event_rw
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure event_rw for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud ACK"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud ACK: Mandate ActionTrail Multi-Region Audit Logging"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0235"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ack", label: "Alibaba Cloud ACK", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_ack_admission_gate_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce Strict Kubernetes Pod Admission via ACK Gatekeeper (Tier-9 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_cs_managed_kubernetes"
  not r.change.after.cluster_spec
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure cluster_spec for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_rds_high_availability_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Require Multi-AZ Primary/Standby RDS High Availability (Tier-10 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_db_instance"
  not r.change.after.category
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure category for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud ACK"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud ACK: Require Multi-AZ Primary/Standby RDS High Availability"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0237"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ack", label: "Alibaba Cloud ACK", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_ecs_key_pair_only_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce Key Pair SSH Authentication & Password Disabled (Tier-11 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_instance"
  not r.change.after.key_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure key_name for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_dns_privatezone_protection_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce PrivateZone DNSSEC & Resolver Isolation (Tier-12 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_pvtz_zone"
  not r.change.after.zone_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure zone_name for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud ACK"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce PrivateZone DNSSEC & Resolver Isolation"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0239"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ack", label: "Alibaba Cloud ACK", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_sg_ingress_boundary_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce Restrictive Security Group Ingress Filtering (Tier-1 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_security_group_rule"
  not r.change.after.nic_type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure nic_type for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change

    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]

      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]

      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_vpc_isolation_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce VPC Subnet Isolation & Private Route Table (Tier-2 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_vswitch"
  not r.change.after.vpc_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure vpc_id for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud ACK"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce VPC Subnet Isolation & Private Route Table"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0241"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ack", label: "Alibaba Cloud ACK", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_oss_kms_encryption_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Require Server-Side Encryption with Customer KMS Key (Tier-3 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.server_side_encryption_rule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure server_side_encryption_rule for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_hbr_backup_lifecycle_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce HBR Automated Backup Lifecycle & Retention (Tier-4 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_hbr_vault"
  not r.change.after.retention
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud ACK"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce HBR Automated Backup Lifecycle & Retention"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0243"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ack", label: "Alibaba Cloud ACK", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_oss_private_access_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Block Public Bucket Access via Bucket Policy (Tier-5 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.acl
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure acl for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud ACK"]

      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0244"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ack", label: "Alibaba Cloud ACK", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_ram_least_privilege_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce RAM Least Privilege & MFA Requirement (Tier-6 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_ram_policy"
  not r.change.after.policy_document
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure policy_document for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud ACK"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce RAM Least Privilege & MFA Requirement"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0245"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ack", label: "Alibaba Cloud ACK", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_storage_encryption_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enable Disk Encryption with Envelope KMS Master Key (Tier-7 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_disk"
  not r.change.after.encrypted
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure encrypted for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_actiontrail_audit_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Mandate ActionTrail Multi-Region Audit Logging (Tier-8 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_actiontrail_trail"
  not r.change.after.event_rw
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure event_rw for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud ACK"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud ACK: Mandate ActionTrail Multi-Region Audit Logging"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0247"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ack", label: "Alibaba Cloud ACK", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_ack_admission_gate_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce Strict Kubernetes Pod Admission via ACK Gatekeeper (Tier-9 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_cs_managed_kubernetes"
  not r.change.after.cluster_spec
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure cluster_spec for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_rds_high_availability_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Require Multi-AZ Primary/Standby RDS High Availability (Tier-10 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_db_instance"
  not r.change.after.category
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure category for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud ACK"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud ACK: Require Multi-AZ Primary/Standby RDS High Availability"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0249"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ack", label: "Alibaba Cloud ACK", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_ecs_key_pair_only_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce Key Pair SSH Authentication & Password Disabled (Tier-11 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_instance"
  not r.change.after.key_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure key_name for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_dns_privatezone_protection_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce PrivateZone DNSSEC & Resolver Isolation (Tier-12 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_pvtz_zone"
  not r.change.after.zone_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure zone_name for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud ACK"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce PrivateZone DNSSEC & Resolver Isolation"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0251"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ack", label: "Alibaba Cloud ACK", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_sg_ingress_boundary_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce Restrictive Security Group Ingress Filtering (Tier-1 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_security_group_rule"
  not r.change.after.nic_type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure nic_type for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end

      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}

      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0252"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ack", label: "Alibaba Cloud ACK", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]

      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ack.alicloud_ack_vpc_isolation_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce VPC Subnet Isolation & Private Route Table (Tier-2 Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK))
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_vswitch"
  not r.change.after.vpc_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure vpc_id for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud ACK"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud ACK: Enforce VPC Subnet Isolation & Private Route Table"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0253"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ack", label: "Alibaba Cloud ACK", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end
