developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_rds_high_availability_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Require Multi-AZ Primary/Standby RDS High Availability (Tier-10 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_db_instance"
  not r.change.after.category
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure category for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce Key Pair SSH Authentication & Password Disabled (Tier-11 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_instance"
  not r.change.after.key_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure key_name for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_dns_privatezone_protection_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce PrivateZone DNSSEC & Resolver Isolation (Tier-12 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_pvtz_zone"
  not r.change.after.zone_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure zone_name for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud DNS"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce PrivateZone DNSSEC & Resolver Isolation"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0356"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-dns", label: "Alibaba Cloud DNS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_sg_ingress_boundary_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce Restrictive Security Group Ingress Filtering (Tier-1 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_security_group_rule"
  not r.change.after.nic_type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure nic_type for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_vpc_isolation_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce VPC Subnet Isolation & Private Route Table (Tier-2 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_vswitch"
  not r.change.after.vpc_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure vpc_id for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-dns", label: "Alibaba Cloud DNS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]

      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_oss_kms_encryption_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Require Server-Side Encryption with Customer KMS Key (Tier-3 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.server_side_encryption_rule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure server_side_encryption_rule for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud DNS"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud DNS: Require Server-Side Encryption with Customer KMS Key"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0359"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-dns", label: "Alibaba Cloud DNS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_hbr_backup_lifecycle_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce HBR Automated Backup Lifecycle & Retention (Tier-4 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_hbr_vault"
  not r.change.after.retention
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_oss_private_access_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Block Public Bucket Access via Bucket Policy (Tier-5 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.acl
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure acl for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud DNS"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud DNS: Block Public Bucket Access via Bucket Policy"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0361"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-dns", label: "Alibaba Cloud DNS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_ram_least_privilege_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce RAM Least Privilege & MFA Requirement (Tier-6 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_ram_policy"
  not r.change.after.policy_document
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure policy_document for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud DNS"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce RAM Least Privilege & MFA Requirement"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0362"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-dns", label: "Alibaba Cloud DNS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_storage_encryption_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enable Disk Encryption with Envelope KMS Master Key (Tier-7 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_disk"
  not r.change.after.encrypted
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure encrypted for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Mandate ActionTrail Multi-Region Audit Logging (Tier-8 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_actiontrail_trail"
  not r.change.after.event_rw
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure event_rw for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end

      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}

      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0364"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-dns", label: "Alibaba Cloud DNS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]

      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_ack_admission_gate_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce Strict Kubernetes Pod Admission via ACK Gatekeeper (Tier-9 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_cs_managed_kubernetes"
  not r.change.after.cluster_spec
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure cluster_spec for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud DNS"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce Strict Kubernetes Pod Admission via ACK Gatekeeper"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0365"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-dns", label: "Alibaba Cloud DNS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_rds_high_availability_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Require Multi-AZ Primary/Standby RDS High Availability (Tier-10 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_db_instance"
  not r.change.after.category
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure category for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce Key Pair SSH Authentication & Password Disabled (Tier-11 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_instance"
  not r.change.after.key_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure key_name for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_dns_privatezone_protection_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce PrivateZone DNSSEC & Resolver Isolation (Tier-12 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_pvtz_zone"
  not r.change.after.zone_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure zone_name for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud DNS"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce PrivateZone DNSSEC & Resolver Isolation"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0368"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-dns", label: "Alibaba Cloud DNS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_sg_ingress_boundary_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce Restrictive Security Group Ingress Filtering (Tier-1 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_security_group_rule"
  not r.change.after.nic_type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure nic_type for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce VPC Subnet Isolation & Private Route Table (Tier-2 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_vswitch"
  not r.change.after.vpc_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure vpc_id for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-dns", label: "Alibaba Cloud DNS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]

      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_oss_kms_encryption_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Require Server-Side Encryption with Customer KMS Key (Tier-3 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.server_side_encryption_rule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure server_side_encryption_rule for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud DNS"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud DNS: Require Server-Side Encryption with Customer KMS Key"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0371"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-dns", label: "Alibaba Cloud DNS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_hbr_backup_lifecycle_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce HBR Automated Backup Lifecycle & Retention (Tier-4 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_hbr_vault"
  not r.change.after.retention
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_oss_private_access_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Block Public Bucket Access via Bucket Policy (Tier-5 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.acl
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure acl for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud DNS"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud DNS: Block Public Bucket Access via Bucket Policy"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0373"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-dns", label: "Alibaba Cloud DNS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_ram_least_privilege_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce RAM Least Privilege & MFA Requirement (Tier-6 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_ram_policy"
  not r.change.after.policy_document
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure policy_document for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud DNS"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce RAM Least Privilege & MFA Requirement"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0374"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-dns", label: "Alibaba Cloud DNS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_storage_encryption_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enable Disk Encryption with Envelope KMS Master Key (Tier-7 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_disk"
  not r.change.after.encrypted
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure encrypted for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Mandate ActionTrail Multi-Region Audit Logging (Tier-8 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_actiontrail_trail"
  not r.change.after.event_rw
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure event_rw for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end

      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}

      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0376"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-dns", label: "Alibaba Cloud DNS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]

      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_ack_admission_gate_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce Strict Kubernetes Pod Admission via ACK Gatekeeper (Tier-9 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_cs_managed_kubernetes"
  not r.change.after.cluster_spec
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure cluster_spec for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud DNS"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce Strict Kubernetes Pod Admission via ACK Gatekeeper"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0377"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-dns", label: "Alibaba Cloud DNS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_dns.alicloud_dns_rds_high_availability_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Require Multi-AZ Primary/Standby RDS High Availability (Tier-10 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_db_instance"
  not r.change.after.category
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure category for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud DNS: Enforce Key Pair SSH Authentication & Password Disabled (Tier-11 Alibaba Cloud DNS & PrivateZone)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_instance"
  not r.change.after.key_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure key_name for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
