opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_ecs_key_pair_only_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Enforce Key Pair SSH Authentication & Password Disabled (Tier-11 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_instance"
  not r.change.after.key_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure key_name for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud HBR"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud HBR: Enforce Key Pair SSH Authentication & Password Disabled"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0410"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-hbr", label: "Alibaba Cloud HBR", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_dns_privatezone_protection_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Enforce PrivateZone DNSSEC & Resolver Isolation (Tier-12 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_pvtz_zone"
  not r.change.after.zone_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure zone_name for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_sg_ingress_boundary_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Enforce Restrictive Security Group Ingress Filtering (Tier-1 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_security_group_rule"
  not r.change.after.nic_type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure nic_type for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_vpc_isolation_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Enforce VPC Subnet Isolation & Private Route Table (Tier-2 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_vswitch"
  not r.change.after.vpc_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure vpc_id for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_oss_kms_encryption_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Require Server-Side Encryption with Customer KMS Key (Tier-3 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.server_side_encryption_rule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure server_side_encryption_rule for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_hbr_backup_lifecycle_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Enforce HBR Automated Backup Lifecycle & Retention (Tier-4 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_hbr_vault"
  not r.change.after.retention
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_oss_private_access_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Block Public Bucket Access via Bucket Policy (Tier-5 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.acl
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure acl for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_ram_least_privilege_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Enforce RAM Least Privilege & MFA Requirement (Tier-6 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_ram_policy"
  not r.change.after.policy_document
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure policy_document for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud HBR"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud HBR: Enforce RAM Least Privilege & MFA Requirement"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0417"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-hbr", label: "Alibaba Cloud HBR", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_storage_encryption_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Enable Disk Encryption with Envelope KMS Master Key (Tier-7 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_disk"
  not r.change.after.encrypted
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure encrypted for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_actiontrail_audit_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Mandate ActionTrail Multi-Region Audit Logging (Tier-8 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_actiontrail_trail"
  not r.change.after.event_rw
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure event_rw for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_ack_admission_gate_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Enforce Strict Kubernetes Pod Admission via ACK Gatekeeper (Tier-9 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_cs_managed_kubernetes"
  not r.change.after.cluster_spec
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure cluster_spec for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.

package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_rds_high_availability_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Require Multi-AZ Primary/Standby RDS High Availability (Tier-10 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_db_instance"
  not r.change.after.category
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure category for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_ecs_key_pair_only_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Enforce Key Pair SSH Authentication & Password Disabled (Tier-11 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_instance"
  not r.change.after.key_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure key_name for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_dns_privatezone_protection_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Enforce PrivateZone DNSSEC & Resolver Isolation (Tier-12 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_pvtz_zone"
  not r.change.after.zone_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure zone_name for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_sg_ingress_boundary_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Enforce Restrictive Security Group Ingress Filtering (Tier-1 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_security_group_rule"
  not r.change.after.nic_type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure nic_type for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud HBR"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud HBR: Enforce Restrictive Security Group Ingress Filtering"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0424"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-hbr", label: "Alibaba Cloud HBR", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_vpc_isolation_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Enforce VPC Subnet Isolation & Private Route Table (Tier-2 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_vswitch"
  not r.change.after.vpc_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure vpc_id for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_oss_kms_encryption_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Require Server-Side Encryption with Customer KMS Key (Tier-3 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.server_side_encryption_rule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure server_side_encryption_rule for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_hbr_backup_lifecycle_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Enforce HBR Automated Backup Lifecycle & Retention (Tier-4 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_hbr_vault"
  not r.change.after.retention
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.

package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_oss_private_access_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Block Public Bucket Access via Bucket Policy (Tier-5 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.acl
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure acl for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_ram_least_privilege_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Enforce RAM Least Privilege & MFA Requirement (Tier-6 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_ram_policy"
  not r.change.after.policy_document
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure policy_document for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_hbr.alicloud_hbr_storage_encryption_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud HBR: Enable Disk Encryption with Envelope KMS Master Key (Tier-7 Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) & Snapshots)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_disk"
  not r.change.after.encrypted
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure encrypted for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_actiontrail.alicloud_actiontrail_sg_ingress_boundary_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Enforce Restrictive Security Group Ingress Filtering (Tier-1 ActionTrail Audit & Event Governance)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_security_group_rule"
  not r.change.after.nic_type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure nic_type for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Enforce Restrictive Security Group Ingress Filtering"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0431"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

package alicloud.alicloud_actiontrail.alicloud_actiontrail_vpc_isolation_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Enforce VPC Subnet Isolation & Private Route Table (Tier-2 ActionTrail Audit & Event Governance)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_vswitch"
  not r.change.after.vpc_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure vpc_id for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_actiontrail.alicloud_actiontrail_oss_kms_encryption_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Require Server-Side Encryption with Customer KMS Key (Tier-3 ActionTrail Audit & Event Governance)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.server_side_encryption_rule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure server_side_encryption_rule for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: API event collection
developer_guide.contract: Event type, resource identity, event time, destination and retention
dependencies: Supported event sources with required categories enabled
A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.
Configure destination permissions and retention.
Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_actiontrail.alicloud_actiontrail_hbr_backup_lifecycle_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Enforce HBR Automated Backup Lifecycle & Retention (Tier-4 ActionTrail Audit & Event Governance)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_hbr_vault"
  not r.change.after.retention
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: API event collection
developer_guide.contract: Event type, resource identity, event time, destination and retention
dependencies: Supported event sources with required categories enabled
A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.
Configure destination permissions and retention.
Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_actiontrail.alicloud_actiontrail_oss_private_access_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Block Public Bucket Access via Bucket Policy (Tier-5 ActionTrail Audit & Event Governance)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.acl
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure acl for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Block Public Bucket Access via Bucket Policy"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0435"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

package alicloud.alicloud_actiontrail.alicloud_actiontrail_ram_least_privilege_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Enforce RAM Least Privilege & MFA Requirement (Tier-6 ActionTrail Audit & Event Governance)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_ram_policy"
  not r.change.after.policy_document
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure policy_document for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.

Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_actiontrail.alicloud_actiontrail_storage_encryption_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Enable Disk Encryption with Envelope KMS Master Key (Tier-7 ActionTrail Audit & Event Governance)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_disk"
  not r.change.after.encrypted
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure encrypted for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: API event collection
developer_guide.contract: Event type, resource identity, event time, destination and retention
dependencies: Supported event sources with required categories enabled
A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.
Configure destination permissions and retention.
Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_actiontrail.alicloud_actiontrail_actiontrail_audit_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Mandate ActionTrail Multi-Region Audit Logging (Tier-8 ActionTrail Audit & Event Governance)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_actiontrail_trail"
  not r.change.after.event_rw
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure event_rw for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: API event collection
developer_guide.contract: Event type, resource identity, event time, destination and retention
dependencies: Supported event sources with required categories enabled
A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.
Configure destination permissions and retention.
Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_actiontrail.alicloud_actiontrail_ack_admission_gate_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Enforce Strict Kubernetes Pod Admission via ACK Gatekeeper (Tier-9 ActionTrail Audit & Event Governance)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_cs_managed_kubernetes"
  not r.change.after.cluster_spec
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure cluster_spec for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Enforce Strict Kubernetes Pod Admission via ACK Gatekeeper"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0439"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

package alicloud.alicloud_actiontrail.alicloud_actiontrail_rds_high_availability_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Require Multi-AZ Primary/Standby RDS High Availability (Tier-10 ActionTrail Audit & Event Governance)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_db_instance"
  not r.change.after.category
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure category for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.

failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

package alicloud.alicloud_actiontrail.alicloud_actiontrail_ecs_key_pair_only_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Enforce Key Pair SSH Authentication & Password Disabled (Tier-11 ActionTrail Audit & Event Governance)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_instance"
  not r.change.after.key_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure key_name for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

package alicloud.alicloud_actiontrail.alicloud_actiontrail_dns_privatezone_protection_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Enforce PrivateZone DNSSEC & Resolver Isolation (Tier-12 ActionTrail Audit & Event Governance)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_pvtz_zone"
  not r.change.after.zone_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure zone_name for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: API event collection
developer_guide.contract: Event type, resource identity, event time, destination and retention
dependencies: Supported event sources with required categories enabled
A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.
Configure destination permissions and retention.
Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_actiontrail.alicloud_actiontrail_sg_ingress_boundary_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Enforce Restrictive Security Group Ingress Filtering (Tier-1 ActionTrail Audit & Event Governance)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_security_group_rule"
  not r.change.after.nic_type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure nic_type for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Enforce Restrictive Security Group Ingress Filtering"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0443"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

package alicloud.alicloud_actiontrail.alicloud_actiontrail_vpc_isolation_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Enforce VPC Subnet Isolation & Private Route Table (Tier-2 ActionTrail Audit & Event Governance)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_vswitch"
  not r.change.after.vpc_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure vpc_id for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_actiontrail.alicloud_actiontrail_oss_kms_encryption_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Require Server-Side Encryption with Customer KMS Key (Tier-3 ActionTrail Audit & Event Governance)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.server_side_encryption_rule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure server_side_encryption_rule for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.contract: Event type, resource identity, event time, destination and retention
dependencies: Supported event sources with required categories enabled
A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.
Configure destination permissions and retention.
Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_actiontrail.alicloud_actiontrail_hbr_backup_lifecycle_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail: Enforce HBR Automated Backup Lifecycle & Retention (Tier-4 ActionTrail Audit & Event Governance)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_hbr_vault"
  not r.change.after.retention
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
