developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_ddos.alicloud_ddos_vpc_isolation_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Enforce VPC Subnet Isolation & Private Route Table (Tier-2 Anti-DDoS Pro & Edge Protection)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_vswitch"
  not r.change.after.vpc_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure vpc_id for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Enforce VPC Subnet Isolation & Private Route Table"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0929"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ddos", label: "Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.

failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_ddos.alicloud_ddos_oss_kms_encryption_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Require Server-Side Encryption with Customer KMS Key (Tier-3 Anti-DDoS Pro & Edge Protection)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.server_side_encryption_rule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure server_side_encryption_rule for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ddos.alicloud_ddos_hbr_backup_lifecycle_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Enforce HBR Automated Backup Lifecycle & Retention (Tier-4 Anti-DDoS Pro & Edge Protection)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_hbr_vault"
  not r.change.after.retention
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ddos.alicloud_ddos_oss_private_access_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Block Public Bucket Access via Bucket Policy (Tier-5 Anti-DDoS Pro & Edge Protection)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.acl
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure acl for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.

package alicloud.alicloud_ddos.alicloud_ddos_ram_least_privilege_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Enforce RAM Least Privilege & MFA Requirement (Tier-6 Anti-DDoS Pro & Edge Protection)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_ram_policy"
  not r.change.after.policy_document
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure policy_document for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.

aws configure list

checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_ddos.alicloud_ddos_storage_encryption_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Enable Disk Encryption with Envelope KMS Master Key (Tier-7 Anti-DDoS Pro & Edge Protection)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_disk"
  not r.change.after.encrypted
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure encrypted for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ddos.alicloud_ddos_actiontrail_audit_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Mandate ActionTrail Multi-Region Audit Logging (Tier-8 Anti-DDoS Pro & Edge Protection)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_actiontrail_trail"
  not r.change.after.event_rw
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure event_rw for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_ddos.alicloud_ddos_ack_admission_gate_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Enforce Strict Kubernetes Pod Admission via ACK Gatekeeper (Tier-9 Anti-DDoS Pro & Edge Protection)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_cs_managed_kubernetes"
  not r.change.after.cluster_spec
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure cluster_spec for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Enforce Strict Kubernetes Pod Admission via ACK Gatekeeper"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0936"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ddos", label: "Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.

package alicloud.alicloud_ddos.alicloud_ddos_rds_high_availability_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Require Multi-AZ Primary/Standby RDS High Availability (Tier-10 Anti-DDoS Pro & Edge Protection)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_db_instance"
  not r.change.after.category
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure category for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ddos.alicloud_ddos_ecs_key_pair_only_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Enforce Key Pair SSH Authentication & Password Disabled (Tier-11 Anti-DDoS Pro & Edge Protection)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_instance"
  not r.change.after.key_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure key_name for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_ddos.alicloud_ddos_dns_privatezone_protection_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Enforce PrivateZone DNSSEC & Resolver Isolation (Tier-12 Anti-DDoS Pro & Edge Protection)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_pvtz_zone"
  not r.change.after.zone_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure zone_name for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Enforce PrivateZone DNSSEC & Resolver Isolation"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0939"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ddos", label: "Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.

aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list

checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ddos.alicloud_ddos_sg_ingress_boundary_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Enforce Restrictive Security Group Ingress Filtering (Tier-1 Anti-DDoS Pro & Edge Protection)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_security_group_rule"
  not r.change.after.nic_type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure nic_type for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ddos.alicloud_ddos_vpc_isolation_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Enforce VPC Subnet Isolation & Private Route Table (Tier-2 Anti-DDoS Pro & Edge Protection)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_vswitch"
  not r.change.after.vpc_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure vpc_id for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ddos.alicloud_ddos_oss_kms_encryption_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Require Server-Side Encryption with Customer KMS Key (Tier-3 Anti-DDoS Pro & Edge Protection)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.server_side_encryption_rule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure server_side_encryption_rule for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ddos.alicloud_ddos_hbr_backup_lifecycle_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Enforce HBR Automated Backup Lifecycle & Retention (Tier-4 Anti-DDoS Pro & Edge Protection)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_hbr_vault"
  not r.change.after.retention
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ddos.alicloud_ddos_oss_private_access_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Block Public Bucket Access via Bucket Policy (Tier-5 Anti-DDoS Pro & Edge Protection)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.acl
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure acl for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_ddos.alicloud_ddos_ram_least_privilege_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Enforce RAM Least Privilege & MFA Requirement (Tier-6 Anti-DDoS Pro & Edge Protection)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_ram_policy"
  not r.change.after.policy_document
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure policy_document for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.

aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_ddos.alicloud_ddos_storage_encryption_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Enable Disk Encryption with Envelope KMS Master Key (Tier-7 Anti-DDoS Pro & Edge Protection)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_disk"
  not r.change.after.encrypted
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure encrypted for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS: Enable Disk Encryption with Envelope KMS Master Key"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0946"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ddos", label: "Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.

package alicloud.alicloud_pai.alicloud_pai_sg_ingress_boundary_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud PAI: Enforce Restrictive Security Group Ingress Filtering (Tier-1 Platform for AI (PAI) & Model Security)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_security_group_rule"
  not r.change.after.nic_type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure nic_type for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud PAI: Enforce VPC Subnet Isolation & Private Route Table (Tier-2 Platform for AI (PAI) & Model Security)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_vswitch"
  not r.change.after.vpc_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure vpc_id for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_pai.alicloud_pai_oss_kms_encryption_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud PAI: Require Server-Side Encryption with Customer KMS Key (Tier-3 Platform for AI (PAI) & Model Security)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.server_side_encryption_rule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure server_side_encryption_rule for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud PAI"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud PAI: Require Server-Side Encryption with Customer KMS Key"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0949"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-pai", label: "Alibaba Cloud PAI", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_pai.alicloud_pai_hbr_backup_lifecycle_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud PAI: Enforce HBR Automated Backup Lifecycle & Retention (Tier-4 Platform for AI (PAI) & Model Security)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_hbr_vault"
  not r.change.after.retention
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_pai.alicloud_pai_oss_private_access_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud PAI: Block Public Bucket Access via Bucket Policy (Tier-5 Platform for AI (PAI) & Model Security)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_oss_bucket"
  not r.change.after.acl
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure acl for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud PAI"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud PAI: Block Public Bucket Access via Bucket Policy"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0951"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-pai", label: "Alibaba Cloud PAI", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_pai.alicloud_pai_ram_least_privilege_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud PAI: Enforce RAM Least Privilege & MFA Requirement (Tier-6 Platform for AI (PAI) & Model Security)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_ram_policy"
  not r.change.after.policy_document
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure policy_document for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_pai.alicloud_pai_storage_encryption_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud PAI: Enable Disk Encryption with Envelope KMS Master Key (Tier-7 Platform for AI (PAI) & Model Security)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_disk"
  not r.change.after.encrypted
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure encrypted for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_pai.alicloud_pai_actiontrail_audit_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud PAI: Mandate ActionTrail Multi-Region Audit Logging (Tier-8 Platform for AI (PAI) & Model Security)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_actiontrail_trail"
  not r.change.after.event_rw
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure event_rw for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud PAI"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud PAI: Mandate ActionTrail Multi-Region Audit Logging"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0954"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-pai", label: "Alibaba Cloud PAI", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_pai.alicloud_pai_ack_admission_gate_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud PAI: Enforce Strict Kubernetes Pod Admission via ACK Gatekeeper (Tier-9 Platform for AI (PAI) & Model Security)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_cs_managed_kubernetes"
  not r.change.after.cluster_spec
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure cluster_spec for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package alicloud.alicloud_pai.alicloud_pai_rds_high_availability_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud PAI: Require Multi-AZ Primary/Standby RDS High Availability (Tier-10 Platform for AI (PAI) & Model Security)
# Compliance: CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0, MLPS Level 3, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_db_instance"
  not r.change.after.category
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure category for compliance standard CIS Alibaba Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_pai.alicloud_pai_ecs_key_pair_only_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud PAI: Enforce Key Pair SSH Authentication & Password Disabled (Tier-11 Platform for AI (PAI) & Model Security)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_instance"
  not r.change.after.key_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure key_name for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud PAI"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud PAI: Enforce Key Pair SSH Authentication & Password Disabled"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0957"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-pai", label: "Alibaba Cloud PAI", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.

package alicloud.alicloud_pai.alicloud_pai_dns_privatezone_protection_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud PAI: Enforce PrivateZone DNSSEC & Resolver Isolation (Tier-12 Platform for AI (PAI) & Model Security)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_pvtz_zone"
  not r.change.after.zone_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure zone_name for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package alicloud.alicloud_pai.alicloud_pai_sg_ingress_boundary_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Alibaba Cloud PAI: Enforce Restrictive Security Group Ingress Filtering (Tier-1 Platform for AI (PAI) & Model Security)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "alicloud_security_group_rule"
  not r.change.after.nic_type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure nic_type for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Alibaba Cloud CLI (aliyun) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Alibaba Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Alibaba Cloud PAI"]
      requirement["Alibaba Cloud PAI: Enforce Restrictive Security Group Ingress Filtering"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-ram", label: "Alibaba Cloud RAM policy and Resource Directory", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: ALICLOUD-BP-0959"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Alibaba Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-pai", label: "Alibaba Cloud PAI", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:alicloud-actiontrail", label: "Supported ActionTrail management events and Security Center alerts", h: 64, pos: "b" }

      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end
